705330101.text: What a surprise. To think that my invention could be used in this fashion...

705330102.text: Ah, Traveler! It seems we meet again... *cough*

705330104.text: That was the plan, yes, but... Things do change, you know...

705330108.text: *cough* But let's get back on topic.

705330109.text: This time, I've been invited by the Mondstadt Adventurers' Guild to create several Mechanical Paintings based on certain card faces that can be disassembled and reassembled.

705330110.text: As for the card game, what was it again... Ah, right, it's called Genius Invokation TCG.

705330111.text: According to them, these paintings will be brought to be used in the King of Invokations Grand Prix as a sort of minigame to liven things up just a bit.

705330112.text: *sigh* These things are too complicated for me. I should just concentrate on my inventions.

705330113.text: Ah, yes, Mondstadt's mechanical paintings are with me, so if you want to play around with them, feel free.

705330106.text: No, not at all! Not this time... Or should I say, there was never a problem.

705330107.text: When I asked you for your help previously, I was having a monster problem, not an invention problem!
